She is a resident of [[Arborville]] in [[Johto]] and the granddaughter of [[Towa]]. ==History== [[File:Diana and Towa.png|thumb|left|250px|Diana and her grandmother, Towa]] Diana met {{Ash}} and {{Ashfr}} when [[Towa|her grandmother]] was warning them about going into the nearby forest. {{an|Brock}} flirted with Diana and invited her into the forest for protection, but she stayed behind. When the trio returned with an [[Sam|injured boy]], they went to Diana first, but he woke up before she was able to do anything. After learning that Sam was with a {{OBP|Celebi|M04}} the day he disappeared, Diana came to the conclusion that it must have been because Celebi felt they were both in danger and they had to get out of there as fast as possible. After seeing a storm of earth and forest debris, Diana and her grandmother went to rescue Ash, Sam, and the others from the forest in [[Mr. White]]'s blimp. Soon after picking up Ash and the others, Celebi's {{m|Hyper Beam}} brought the blimp down. After Celebi was able to fight off the effects of the [[Dark Ball]] in which it was captured by the [[Iron-Masked Marauder]], it remained injured and weak. Brock suggested putting it into the [[Lake of Life]], but because it was tainted, it had no effect. Diana suggested that {{OBP|Suicune|M04}}—who had fought against the Iron-Masked Marauder—could purify the water. Diana watched as a group of {{p|Celebi}} arrived and helped Celebi to recover from its injuries, and then confronted the Iron-Masked Marauder following his defeat. Diana was last seen waving goodbye to Ash and his friends as they set off to continue their journey. ==Character== Diana is seemingly more easy-going than [[Towa|her grandmother]], but does get defensive when the things and people she holds dear are threatened. ==Artwork== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color}}" | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color light}}; overflow:hidden"| [[File:Sugimori Diana M04.png|x300px]] |- | [[Ken Sugimori]]'s design of Diana |}{{-}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{grass color}}|bordercolor={{grass color light}} |ja=鈴木杏 ''Anne Suzuki'' |en=[[Roxanne Beck]] |de=Andrea Wick |fi=Mirjami Heikkinen |he=דון לני-גבאי ''Dawn Lanny-Gabay'' |fr_eu=Laurence Sacquet |no=Ine Jansen |es_eu=Mar Bordallo |es_la=Jessica Ortiz |pt_br=Tânia Gaidarji (original dub)
